newsitem.title: PERU: U.S. tourist falls to death at Peruvian ruins. [CORRECTED 18:37 GMT]
newsitem.headline: U.S. tourist falls to death at Peruvian ruins. [CORRECTED 18:37 GMT]

text.p: An elderly U.S. tourist plunged 300 feet (91 metres) to her death while visiting the ancient Inca ruins of Machu Picchu, Peruvian police said on Friday.

Ingrid Mason, 70, from Colorado, slipped and fell on Wednesday while her tour group scaled the Huayna Picchu peak overlooking the Inca citadel, said a police spokesman in Cuzco 730 miles (1,170 km) southeast of Lima.
(Corrects to show Inca citadel is not in Cuzco).
Mason died from head injuries, the spokesman said. No foul play was suspected.
